data.title: 阿尔法 · 极光雪原的终局巡弋
data.description: 凛冬雪岭悬崖之巅，漫天绿色极光倾泻而下。阿尔法单手反握史莱姆黑刃按剑卓立，金色长发在极地寒风中猎猎翻卷。
data.location: frozen snowy cliff precipice under vast vibrant polar aurora borealis
data.action: standing poised atop windswept snow crag, hand resting on black slime blade hilt, cape fluttering wildly, resolute commanding gaze
data.promptProse: Alpha stands resolutely on a frozen cliff ridge under shimmering green auroras, holding her dark slime blade as polar gusts catch her coat.
data.animaCaption: Green auroral light outlines her silhouette on the windswept snow crest.
